question: How does union with pure principle remove limited-being power?
premises: pure principle union removes limited-being power
such yogi becomes lord of world
inference: Union with pure principle transforms limited being into world-lordship.
uncertainties: some fused sandhi forms kept whole
plain_english: Through union with the pure principle, limited-being power is removed; reflecting the universe as Shiva-filled, the yogi becomes lord of the world.
